permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connect to your own Mac relay for transcription and messages with your existing Dot. 自分のMac中継で音声認識し、既存のDotとメッセージをやり取りします。

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Record speech when you hold to talk. If you enable Hey dot, keep the G2 microphone open while Dot Link is active to detect the cue locally on your phone. Only your following utterance is sent for transcription, for up to 30 seconds.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: When you turn on location sharing, share your phone's current location with your own Dot through your Mac for relevant suggestions. 位置情報の共有をオンにしたとき、スマートフォンの現在地を自分のMac経由でいつものDotに共有し、場所に応じた案内に使います。
